item.title: Battery announce kickoff times, single-game tickets, theme matches for 2026 season
item.description: The Charleston Battery officially unveiled kickoff times and theme matches for the club’s 2025 USL Championship and Prinx Tires USL Cup home schedule, with single-game tickets available for purchase now on SeatGeek.com.

item.title: Costa Launches “Costa Passport 2026”
item.description: Costa in downtown Charleston has announced Costa Passport 2026, a curated, yearlong series of immersive Italian dining experiences designed to bring the country’s regional culinary traditions to life.

item.title: South Carolina Edges Orlando in Overtime, 2-1
item.description: After seeing a one-goal lead slip late, Simon Pinard buried the overtime game-winning goal 5:34 into the extra frame to push the South Carolina Stingrays past the Orlando Solar Bears, 2-1, on Tuesday evening at the Kia Center.

item.title: The Dunlin to host Lowcountry celebration closing out SEWE weekend
item.description: The Dunlin, Auberge Collection will host a signature Lowcountry celebration from 5 to 7 p.m. Friday, Feb. 15, at its River Barns, marking the finale of Southeastern Wildlife Exposition weekend.

item.title: How Dentists Help With Sleep Apnea Treatment in Las Vegas
item.description: If you struggle with restless nights or daytime fatigue, you might not realize your dentist could be a key part of your sleep apnea care in Las Vegas. Dentists do more than check teeth—they spot early signs of airway issues and craft tailored oral devices to keep your breathing steady. Understanding their role could change how you approach treatment and improve your health more than you expect. What exactly do these treatments involve?

item.title: Three Casinos (Fairly) Near Charleston That Are Worth a Visit
item.description: If you're a fan of gambling and you live in South Carolina, you're options are rather limited. However, several states surrounding SC have legalized casino gambling for licensed premises - so there are a few exciting options within a day's drive. But which are the best of the bunch?

item.title: Michael Burry's $1.3 Billion Bet: Why Nvidia Is the Next Cisco
item.description: For several months now, Michael Burry, the investor featured in the film "The Big Short", has been at the center of controversy for his statements on X, where he points the finger at tech giants. In Q3 2025, he purchased about $1.3 billion in put options against Nvidia and Palantir, betting on the AI bubble bursting.

item.title: The Impact of Injuries on Health and Recovery
item.description: Injuries interrupt more than a moment. They can reshape how you move, think, sleep, and plan your days. Recovery is rarely a straight line, and it often requires attention to both the body and the mind.
